name: A6 amendment (stops removed, shaped reward, GPU continual prequential)
kernel: no position/day stop, no forced target; kill = fault only (gap/discontinuity, nonfinite, OHLC invariant, ledger identity, manual) -> episode aborted, valid prefix kept, no simulated flatten, run FAIL
account: executed U, last target, pending flag, signed pending qty, clip(position_pnl/100,-10,10), pending age/60 m, clip(flat_streak_h/24,0,4), log(RV24h/RV_ref)

reward.formula: net4 - idle - inventory - turnover per 5-minute block
reward.user_choice: option 3 (middle): idle 0.4167 bps per flat hour (10 bps/day at median volatility), m(t) = clip(RV24h/RV_ref, .25, 4) with RV_ref the expanding past median fixed per month, f(k) = 1 + 0.05 min(k, 20) (k = consecutive flat hours, reset after 60 consecutive executed non-flat minutes), inventory 0.15 bps/h x |U|, turnover 0.25 bps x |d target|

engineering.batch_kernel: numba SoA, parity 100k decisions <= 1e-8 vs scalar
engineering.policy: 948-256-256 LayerNorm+SiLU, heads 9/3/1, value dropout 0.1, AdamW wd 1e-4

runs.P2: 2021 (2021-01-30..2022-01-01) pretrain 10M decisions x seeds 0..4, random 28-day flat-start episodes
runs.P3: 2022-01..2025-12 monthly prequential: normalizer refit on rows before the month; evaluate first with 8 action RNG sampled trajectories x 6 cells on a continuous ledger; frozen-2021 anchor evaluated alongside; then the month joins the pool (replay 50/25/25, regime-balanced starts, 28-day episodes) and every seed trains 2M decisions
runs.stop_rules: only fault / leakage / TEST read / parity failure; no performance stop
runs.pass_criteria: A3: stitched net4 6/6 > 0, baseline excess 6/6, yearly 24/24 > 0, round trips 24/24 >= 30, bootstrap p05 18/18 > 0, net4/MDD 6/6 >= 1, flat < .95, >= 3/5 seeds 6/6
